decision_basis: KEEP, INSERT, SUBSTITUTION, and DELETE targets are deterministic and exact-likelihood constructible from expected text and one CTC posterior.
The full candidate space is finite and linear in expected length: 80*N+41.
R4 supplies inspected KEEP/SUB/DELETE construction mechanics in the same frozen CTC likelihood family.
R5-1A supplies alignability-safe impossible-target, TARGET normalization, tie, serialization, and batching mechanisms.
Explicit SUB/DELETE competitors have a direct mechanistic relationship to frozen substitution/deletion false-positive cohorts.
A TRAIN-only speaker-LOSO experiment can be preregistered without consuming TEST or treating current VALIDATION as independent confirmation.
preferred_next_hypothesis: A single preregistered relation-competitive exact CTC score should compare BEST_INSERT with the strongest permitted KEEP/SUBSTITUTION/DELETE explanation in one TARGET-normalized, alignability-safe likelihood space.
important_nonclaims: No final mathematical margin, threshold, or gate has been selected.
Relation competition is not claimed to cancel speaker shift.
The R5-1 result remains closed and unchanged.
smallest_next_action: Create a separate R5-2B TRAIN-only development contract that freezes one relation-competition formula, empty-target handling, tie rules, metrics, gates, and stop policy before any inference.
